name: Pretwa
boardDescription: Three concentric circles divided by three equally spaced diameters (six spokes); 19 intersection points including the center where the diameters meet.
ruleNotes: Captures compulsory, by the short leap as in draughts/Alquerque; each capture must run exclusively along one concentric circle or one diameter, but consecutive captures in one turn may switch between them. Win by capturing all enemy pieces or reducing them to three (some sources say capture-all only). Stalemate loses; if no more captures are possible, the player with more pieces wins, equal counts draw.
sources: H.J.R. Murray, A History of Board-Games Other Than Chess (1952), p.71 (via Wikipedia 'Pretwa' article)
